literal_meaning: ঘন ঘন ঠাসাঠাসি করে সংকুল (tightly and densely packed together)
figurative_meaning_en: mutually densely packed or crowded together
example_sentences_in_bangla: বাসে যাত্রীরা ঠাসাঠাসি হয়ে বসে আছে।
example_sentences_in_english: The passengers are sitting packed tightly in the bus.
People are milling about crowded together at the fair.
note: Synonyms include গাদাগাদি and ঘেঁষাঘেঁষি, emphasizing close physical proximity in Bengali colloquial usage.
